#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
using namespace std;

double func(double x, double n) {
    return -n * (n * n - 3 * n - 3 * x * x + 9 * x - 4) / (2 * (x - 2) * (x - 1) * x);
}

int main() {
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    stringstream ss(line);
    int x;
    double p;
    ss >> x >> p;
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= x; i++) {
        if (func((double)x, (double)i) >= p) {
            ans = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    cout << ans;
    return 0;
}
